claim_limits: Requested model or alias is recorded separately from any actually observed resolved model.
CLI help/version and prepared argv are not native qualification.
No clean-room, cross-family or host-enforcement guarantee follows from a fresh session.
A process timeout/failed authentication remains a failed mandatory case until resolved; no fabricated success or blind retry.

claude.settings: Only explicit disposable project/session settings. Do not use bare mode because it bypasses the available OAuth/keychain route.

codex.settings: Session-local CLI overrides; existing authentication path remains unchanged.

environment.HOME_and_CODEX_HOME: Preserve existing values; do not repurpose or mutate global configuration.
environment.STDO_STORE: Deliberately unrelated private path may be selected to exercise explicit launcher consumption.
environment.credential_values: Pass existing authentication unchanged; never read, serialize or hash secret values.

standing: Parameterized preparation only; substitute exact verified paths/model and record final argv before actual launch. No native session has run.
